scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir apps/api install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir .pnpm-store && pnpm --dir apps/web install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir .pnpm-store
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/api typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/api test && pnpm --dir apps/web test
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
